messages:
sana_support: Heads up — multiple customers reporting 504/502s from the /v1/rerank endpoint during a mid-day traffic spike (QPS ~350-420). p95 token latency jumps from ~120ms -> ~1.2s, gateway timeouts increase, retries amplify errors. Anyone triaging? :frowning:

mike_runtime: copying in logs now. seeing a pattern of upstream timeouts from the rerank pool: `upstream request timed out` and `context deadline exceeded` in the gateway. No obvious 5xx from the model process itself yet.

emma_obs: alert fired at 2026-03-16T15:04:02Z for rerank.p95 > 900ms for 3 consecutive minutes. Top traces show heavy queuing in the rerank gateway handler — a lot of concurrent inflight requests for large candidate lists (N=250+).

calvin_prod: repro steps I ran locally:
```
# replay a 5 minute sustained spike with 200 concurrent clients
hey -n 20000 -c 200 -m POST -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input": "query","candidates":[...250 items...]}' https://api.redwood.run/v1/rerank
```
Result: p95 jumps and gateway starts returning 502/504 once concurrency goes past ~120. Logs show `pool queue full, rejecting request` from gateway.

sana_support: Customer impact — partial rollout blocked for one customer and another reported degraded UX. Marking as P1 for support.

mike_runtime: thoughts: looks like the gateway concurrency-latch (per-worker request queue) is getting saturated by huge candidate lists that blow up internal scoring time and KV cache pressure. When the gateway queue fills we see immediate 502s, then clients retry causing retry amplification.

emma_obs: attaching a small excerpt from traces (sanitized):
```
handler.go:145 handleRerank start
kvcache.go:78 miss, fetching 250 keys
model_runner.go:301 infer start (seq_len=1024 batch=64)
model_runner.go:345 infer timeout after 750ms
handler.go:189 upstream request timed out
```

calvin_prod: I also captured request headers: some SDKs send `Content-Length` for the whole large payload and keep connections open. With heavy concurrent large payloads, socket pools get busy. Might be contributing.

mike_runtime: immediate mitigations proposed: 1) enforce smaller default max_candidates (e.g., 100) at gateway for non-enterprise plans, 2) drop/queue very large requests (reject early with 413 + guidance), 3) reduce max_batch_size for rerank models to avoid long tail infer latencies, 4) add adaptive circuit-breaker on the gateway to fail fast instead of queuing.

emma_obs: short-term config tweak we rolled to a small shard: lowered per-worker request queue from 256 -> 64 and enabled jittered backoff in retries. p95 dropped from 1.2s -> ~300-350ms on the shard, errors reduced ~80% during a 10m test. :white_check_mark:

oncall: what's the rollout plan to global? Need a safe path to avoid causing more 502s. Also we should notify customers of expected behavior change if we start rejecting large candidate lists.

mike_runtime: plan: staged roll — shard 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 2 hours while monitoring rerank.p95 and gateway. Create quick flag `rerank.reject_large_candidates` default false. Also add telemetry for candidate_count distribution by customer.

calvin_prod: repro note for eng: large candidate_count + long per-candidate scoring (heavy rerank models, long sequences) seems to blow up KV cache prefetch. Consider prefetch throttling or small-batch kvcache fetch to avoid N^2 effects.

emma_obs: creating graph on dashboard for candidate_count vs p95 per customer. Already seeing steep slope after 120 candidates.

sana_support: proposed customer communication draft: "We're rolling out temporary request size protections on rerank to improve latency and availability. If your application sends >100 candidates please reduce or contact support for dedicated capacity." Want me to open the CS ticket?

oncall: yes, open ticket and CC infra/eng-runtime. Tagging TICKET-4821. Also add note to status page if errors spike during rollout.

mike_runtime: long-term engineering items: - improve KV cache eviction prefetch policy - measure per-candidate scoring cost and add per-request estimated cost gate - autoscale faster on tail-latency signals and allow model-level fast-variant fallback (rerank-lite) when under pressure.

calvin_prod: one more datapoint: some client retries were aggressive (no backoff). We should add guidance in SDKs to respect Retry-After and use exponential jitter for 5xx/504.

sana_support: thanks team. I'll open P1 ticket, notify affected customers with the drafted message, and roll the safe config to 20% now. Will update thread after metrics look stable. :pray:
